label: Fable-like (warm storyteller)
description: Original warm-storyteller narration style. Inspired by the character of a calm fireside narrator; NOT a clone of any proprietary voice. Map onto a voice you are licensed to use.

kokoro.note: Open-source, local, free. See KOKORO-SETUP.md. bm_fable is a warm British male that fits this style natively.

elevenlabs.note: Use a warm licensed voice or your own clone. Lower stability slightly for natural warmth; keep style low so it stays measured, not performative.

macos_say.note: Zero-install fallback. `say -v Daniel -r 150`. Daniel is a warm British male built into macOS.

pollinations.note: OpenAI's `fable` voice (free with GitHub OAuth per MORNING-VOICES.md). Using the actual fable voice as-is is fine; this preset just supplies matching pacing/writing. Do NOT attempt to clone or re-synthesize the voice itself.
